subject: Money
title: The Interest Rate Spread
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Interest Rate Spread usable.

hook.text: Banks pay you 0.5% on savings and charge 7% on loans. That 6.5% gap is how banks print profits.

buildup.text: This is the net interest margin. Borrow cheap, lend expensive. The spread is banking's oldest business.

discovery.text: US banks earned $200 billion in net interest income in 2023. The spread is enormous at scale.

twist.text: When the Fed raises rates, banks raise loan rates instantly but savings rates lag months behind. Deliberate.

climax.text: The spread exploits depositor inertia. Moving your money is hassle. Banks profit from your laziness.

punchline.text: Your patience is their profit margin.

quiz.question: What is the net interest margin?
options: Gap between lending and borrowing rates
